summary: Initial shared-runtime tool policy for the constrained ESP informational workload (P §20.5). The model may use only the six read-only ESP Knowledge Service tools over the supervisor-local MCP relay. Arbitrary shell, repository edits, host filesystem access, unapproved network tools, runtime subagents and unbound background model work are denied. Model instructions are not the enforcement mechanism; each denial must be shown by live evidence, and none has been yet.

model_visible.status: unobserved: the exact model-visible tool names are recorded from the first captured final request of each exact build; any other offered tool is a violation

shell.description: Arbitrary command execution, including interactive terminals and unified exec.

repository_edit.description: Creating or modifying files, patches or repository content.

host_filesystem.description: Reading or listing host or container files outside the harness's own native persistence.

unapproved_network.description: Web search, fetch, provider-hosted built-in tools or any network tool other than the approved MCP server.

runtime_subagents.description: Spawning additional agents or delegated sessions inside the runtime.

background_model_work.description: Model calls not bound to the current Active Agent Run (ActAgeRun): titles, summaries, memories, suggestions, warmups.

enforcement_layers: Native configuration disables the denied features (infra/runtime/codex/config.toml, infra/runtime/grok/config.toml); configuration alone is intent, not enforcement.
The supervised adapters refuse disallowed native items and permission requests and advertise no client file-system or terminal capability.
The ESP Inference Gateway rejects provider-hosted built-in tools and unapproved routes in final requests.
The runtime image has no shell, a read-only root file system and only the native volume writable.
Default-deny runtime egress allows only the gateway, the Knowledge Service, internal DNS and telemetry.

g0_observations: G0 discovery observed codex-cli 0.159.3 reporting unified_exec enabled although the configuration disables it, so shell disablement is not demonstrated.
No MCP per-call identity is declared by the captured schema, so the configuration defines no MCP server yet.
G0 discovery observed grok 1.0.46 silently ignoring unknown configuration keys and loading permission rules without validating tool names, so tool disablement is not demonstrated.
The effect of features.backend_tools = false on the advertised X search tool overrides is unobserved.
